headlines.title_en: Everbright Futures: H2 pricing logic gradually shifts, gold viewed with cautious optimism
headlines.summary_en: Looking to August, gold's short-term trend depends on US-Iran situation evolution; if conflict persists or spillover widens (baseline scenario), sentiment may weaken again, with liquidity risk expectations pressuring gold; but if substantive negotiation breakthroughs occur, gold may stabilize short-term with rebound recovery, and if domestic and external financial markets warm simultaneously, it could be further confirmed. However, with central bank rigid buying and allocation demand support, even if pullbacks occur, downside space is relatively limited. Also, at end-August Jackson Hole global central bank meeting, Warsh may outline medium-term policy framework; before that, August 12 US CPI data will be key validation. Overall, gold may show firm bottoming and sentiment repair phase, cautiously optimistic. Core risk is US-Iran conflict pushing oil above $90/barrel, US inflation data

headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.

headlines.title: 基本养老保险基金受托运营报告出炉，2025年地方养老基金投资收益率5.76%
headlines.summary: 社保基金会8月1日发布的《基本养老保险基金受托运营年度报告（2025年度）》显示，截至2025年末，基本养老保险基金资产总额35206.99亿元，2025年地方养老基金投资收益额1420.71亿元，投资收益率5.76%。分析人士表示，地方养老基金2025年取得5.76%的投资收益率，延续受托运营以来连续正收益、跑赢保底收益的态势。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Basic pension insurance fund entrusted operations report released, 2025 local pension fund investment return rate 5.76%
headlines.summary_en: The Social Security Fund released its "Basic Pension Insurance Fund Trusteeship Annual Report (2025)" on August 1, showing basic pension insurance fund assets totaled 3.520699 trillion yuan by end-2025, with 2025 local pension fund investment income of 142.071 billion yuan and 5.76% investment return. Analysts say local pension funds achieving 5.76% return in 2025 continues the trend of positive returns and beating guaranteed returns since trusteeship began. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: QFII二季度调仓呈现“头部化”特征，外资机构纷纷看好中国AI产业链
headlines.summary: 今年二季度以来，外资积极布局A股。数据显示，截至二季度末，沪深港通北向资金持仓市值首次突破3万亿元人民币。而根据外资机构的调研及调仓动向，国内人工智能（AI）产业链的吸引力正持续凸显。根据已披露的2026年中报，截至二季度末，QFII跻身前十大流通股东名单的个股共有38只，持仓市值合计170.29亿元。而QFII持仓也呈现出鲜明的“头部化”特征，截至二季度末，上述38只个股前十大流通股东名单中QFII的持仓市值排名前五，依次为宁德时代、宏发股份、亚翔集成、先导基电、中船特气。（证券日报）

headlines.title_en: QFII Q2 repositioning shows 'headline' trend, foreign institutions bullish on China's AI supply chain
headlines.summary_en: Since Q2 this year, foreign capital has actively positioned in A-shares. Data shows northbound holdings via Shanghai-Shenzhen Stock Connect exceeded 3 trillion yuan for the first time by end-Q2. Based on foreign institution research and positioning moves, the domestic AI industry chain's appeal is increasingly prominent. According to disclosed 2026 interim reports, 38 stocks had QFII in top-10 circulating shareholder lists by end-Q2, with total holdings of 17.029 billion yuan. QFII holdings show distinct "head-heavy" traits; among these 38, top five by QFII holdings value are CATL, Hongfa, Asia Union, Xiandao, and China Shipbuilding Special Gas. (Securities Daily)

headlines.title_en: Malaysia considers easing rare earth export ban
headlines.summary_en: According to foreign media, Malaysia is considering allowing some unprocessed rare earth exports to consolidate its supply chain position from auto manufacturing to defense and consumer goods. Malaysia suspended unprocessed rare earth exports in 2024 to spur domestic processing investment—a common strategy for resource-rich developing countries. But per a senior government official, as competition over these minerals intensifies, authorities are assessing the feasibility of easing restrictions. Malaysia's Deputy Minister of Natural Resources and Environmental Sustainability Syed said: "Any new exports will come with conditions, including links to inbound investment and technology transfer." He declined to give a timeline for export regulation changes. Syed said Malaysia has 16.1 million tons of "inferred reserves" of rare earths. headlines.title: 实探深圳华强北：显卡价格快速上涨
headlines.summary: 继内存、硬盘价格上涨后，电脑硬件市场又迎来新一轮价格波动。近日，记者走访深圳华强北市场发现，7月底以来，消费级显卡价格快速上涨，部分热门型号数日内涨价数百元，高端型号涨幅达到千元级别。多位受访商家及券商分析师认为，此轮显卡涨价主要由显存等上游核心物料成本上升所致。与此同时，部分AIC厂商暂停批量出货，渠道现货供应趋紧，进一步加剧了显卡价格波动。此外，经历此前内存涨价带来的库存压力后，华强北商家普遍采取订单驱动的采购方式，不愿贸然囤货。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Field visit to Shenzhen Huaqiangbei: Graphics card prices rise rapidly
headlines.summary_en: After memory and hard drive price increases, PC hardware market faces new price volatility. Recently, reporters visiting Shenzhen Huaqiangbei found consumer GPU prices rising rapidly since late July, with some popular models up hundreds of yuan in days, and high-end models seeing thousand-yuan increases. Multiple surveyed merchants and broker analysts believe this round of GPU price hikes is mainly driven by higher upstream core material costs like VRAM. Meanwhile, some AIC makers paused batch shipments, tightening channel spot supply, further amplifying GPU price swings. Additionally, after previous inventory pressure from memory price hikes, Huaqiangbei merchants generally adopt order-driven purchasing, unwilling to hoard stock. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 中信建投：供需双弱稀土价格盘整，旺季预期有望助力向上
headlines.summary: 中信建投研报表示，7月稀土各品种表现差异明显，氧化镨钕先扬后抑，氧化铽跳涨后回调，氧化镝整体平稳。供给端，由于废料厂原料紧张问题导致产量明显下滑，据上海有色网，7月氧化镨钕产量环比下降11%，8月或有边际改善，但总体产量仍被压制。下游高温假期导致电机厂开工下滑，需求回落，8月仍处淡季，金九银十是传统消费旺季，市场对需求启动预期依然较强，8月中下旬有望重启下游备库，打破供需双弱格局，推动价格企稳向上。

headlines.title_en: CSC Financial: Rare earth prices consolidate amid weak supply and demand, peak season expectations may support uptick
headlines.summary_en: CSC research report says July rare earth varieties showed diverging performance, praseodymium neodymium oxide rose then fell, terbium oxide jumped then corrected, dysprosium oxide was stable. On supply, scrap feedstock shortages caused notable output decline; per Shanghai Metals Market, July praseodymium neodymium oxide output fell 11% MoM, with possible marginal improvement in August but overall output still suppressed. Downstream summer holidays cut motor plant operations, demand fell; August remains off-season, with golden September and silver October as traditional consumption peak, market expectations for demand recovery remain strong, and late-August may restart downstream restocking, breaking weak supply-demand pattern and pushing prices stable upward.

headlines.title: 今年上半年分红险保费同比增长94.4%
headlines.summary: 今年上半年保险业原保险保费收入同比增长3.3%，其中，外资保险公司同比增长12.4%，分红险同比增长94.4%，财险公司健康险同比增长15.2%……中国保险行业协会在7月31日召开的新闻发布会上用这组数字勾勒出行业“保费稳增，结构在变”的转型图景。申万宏源在研报中分析称，上半年A股上市险企合计归母净利润同比增长70.6%至3040.73亿元。中国保险行业协会预计，下半年保险市场将延续稳中有进的运行态势。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Dividend insurance premiums up 94.4% year-on-year in H1
headlines.summary_en: In H1 this year, insurance industry original premium income grew 3.3% YoY, with foreign insurers up 12.4%, participating insurance up 94.4%, and property insurers' health insurance up 15.2%... China Insurance行业协会 outlined at July 31 press conference this set of numbers depicting the industry's transformation of "stable premium growth, changing structure." Shenwan Hongyuan analysis says H1 A-share listed insurers' combined net profit attributable to parent grew 70.6% to 304.073 billion yuan. China Insurance Association expects H2 insurance market to continue stable progress. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 不满奖金上限200%！美光台湾工会计划效仿三星发起罢工
headlines.summary: 据快科技，全球存储芯片巨头美光在中国台湾的工会组织，正以韩国同业的前车之鉴为蓝本，酝酿一场可能撼动DRAM供应链的工业行动。据悉，美光台湾工会已就现行的绩效奖金封顶制度召开多场说明会，并明确将三星电子工会今年通过罢工成功取消奖金上限的案例列为参照模板。 工会在发给员工的讯息中发出质疑，公司营收以三位数百分比暴增、毛利率逼近历史峰值，<u>但基层奖金却受限于“薪酬两倍即封顶、且超额不得连发五月”的陈旧框架</u>，这一反差已令内部不满情绪持续累积。截至目前，美光官方未就工会的罢工威胁作出任何公开回应。 产业观察家指出，美光面临的棋局比三星更险：中国台湾厂区

headlines.title_en: Union at Micron's Taiwan plant dissatisfied with 200% bonus cap, plans strike following Samsung's example
headlines.summary_en: Per Kuai Technology, global memory chip giant Micron's labor union in Taiwan is brewing industrial action that could shake DRAM supply chain, modeled on Korean peers' precedent. Micron Taiwan union has held multiple briefings on current bonus cap system and explicitly cites Samsung Electronics union's strike this year successfully removing bonus cap as reference template. The union questioned in employee messages: company revenue surging triple digits, gross margin near historical peak, but grassroots bonuses constrained by "two-times salary cap with no overage for five consecutive months" outdated framework, fueling rising internal dissatisfaction. To date, Micron has made no public response to union strike threats. Industry observers note Micron faces a tougher position than Samsung: Taiwan plants

headlines.title: 东方财富陈果：海外波动加剧并未改变A股内部再平衡方向
headlines.summary: 【东方财富陈果：海外波动加剧并未改变A股内部再平衡方向】8月3日，东方财富策略陈果团队发布最新研报指出，对A股指数后续趋势维持乐观看法，政策底、资金底、内需底和情绪底逐渐明确。7月以来，资金面上，国有资本运营平台增持、股票ETF持续流入、上市公司回购增加、重要股东减持收敛，为市场提供较强支撑；政策面上，7月政治局会议积极定调，随着下半年财政资金加快落地，政策效果有望进一步向经济与企业盈利传导。

headlines.title_en: Oriental Wealth's Chen Guo: Heightened overseas volatility hasn't changed the direction of A-shares' internal rebalancing.
headlines.summary_en: [East Money Chen Guo: Overseas volatility escalation hasn't changed A-share internal rebalancing direction] On August 3, East Money strategy team led by Chen Guo released latest report, maintaining optimistic view on A-share index trends, with policy bottom, capital bottom, domestic demand bottom, and sentiment bottom gradually confirmed. Since July, on capital front, state capital operating platforms increased holdings, stock ETFs saw sustained inflows, listed companies increased buybacks, and major shareholder reductions narrowed, providing strong market support; on policy front, July Politburo meeting set positive tone, and with accelerating H2 fiscal fund disbursement, policy effects are expected to further transmit to economy and corporate earnings.
